title: Giskard : Byzantine Robust and Private Aggregation for Large-Scale Decentralized Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.19129v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In decentralized learning, clients train a machine learning model while keeping their data locally and share their model parameters or gradients with a set of neighbors, making it vulnerable to both privacy attacks and model poisoning attacks. Jointly addressing privacy and Byzantine behavior in decentralized learning is challenging. Indeed, Differential Privacy (DP) applied on the client side is known to increase the variance of honest model updates, which weakens Byzantine-robust aggregation against poisoning attacks. Distributed DP can mitigate this issue by adding noise after aggregation, but implementing it without a trusted curator requires both confidential and Byzantine-resilient computation. Recent work addresses this challenge using secure multi-party computation (MPC) to implement robust aggregation while preserving input confidentiality. translated_title: Giskard：面向大规模去中心化学习的拜占庭鲁棒且隐私保护的聚合方法
translated_abstract: 在去中心化学习中，客户端在本地保留数据训练机器学习模型，并与一组邻居共享其模型参数或梯度，这使得系统容易受到隐私攻击和模型投毒攻击的双重威胁。在去中心化学习中同时应对隐私问题和拜占庭行为极具挑战性。事实上，已知在客户端应用差分隐私（DP）会增加诚实模型更新的方差，从而削弱拜占庭鲁棒聚合对投毒攻击的抵抗能力。分布式DP可以通过在聚合后添加噪声来缓解这一问题，但在没有可信管理者的情況下实现该方法，需要同时具备机密性和拜占庭弹性的计算。最近的工作使用安全多方计算（MPC）来实现鲁棒聚合，同时保护输入的机密性，然而这些解决方案的可扩展性很差：它们要么需要全对全通信……
tldr: 提出了Giskard，一种面向大规模去中心化学习的拜占庭鲁棒且隐私保护的聚合方法，通过分布式差分隐私与安全多方计算相结合，同时防御模型投毒攻击和隐私攻击，并解决了现有基于MPC的方案可扩展性差的问题。
en_tdlr: Giskard is proposed as a Byzantine-robust and privacy-preserving aggregation method for large-scale decentralized learning, which jointly defends against model poisoning and privacy attacks by combining distributed differential privacy with secure multi-party computation, while overcoming the poor scalability of existing MPC-based solutions.
